description_en: Queries a list of live stream transcoding templates
description_zh: 调用ListLiveTranscodeTemplates获取实时媒体转码模版列表
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-live-transcode-templates --type normal --video-codec H.264 --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --sort-by asc --key-word my_template --category customized --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLiveTranscodeTemplates

parameters.description_en:
The type of the template. Valid values:

- normal

- narrow-band

- audio-only

- origin
parameters.description_zh:

- normal - 普通
- narrow-band - 窄高
- audio-only - 纯音频
- origin - 原画
